items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury; no plans to place on IR.
items.why: Glute; HC confirms no IR plans.
items.implication: Backup QB starts; impacts SEA skill players' efficiency.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games.
items.why: Wrist surgery to quicken recovery; 4-game minimum.
items.implication: ETR/others flag Bateman/Moore as beneficiaries; Flowers role expands if also limited.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins was limited at practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury. History of hamstring issues raises Week 2 availability concerns; further testing ongoing.
items.why: Hamstring limited Wednesday practice; prior multi-game absences on similar injury.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday; potential miss boosts other HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.implication: Likely active; splits carries with Rhamondre Stevenson, volatile FLEX.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; first practice report of week.
items.implication: Threatens role/carries; monitor for DEN RB committee shifts.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday but got mental reps and expects to play Sunday vs Texans.
items.implication: Monitor but plan as starter; CIN WRs (Chase/Higgins) remain viable.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (ribs) did not practice Wednesday and is day-to-day/up in the air for Week 2. ETR flags Tre’ Harris as primary beneficiary if out.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; HC Harbaugh confirmed no Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Questionable; if sits, slot/WR opportunity expands for backups.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top Week 2 waiver wire target after Stribling injury; led slot routes and had red-zone work in Week 1.
items.why: Stribling to IR (ankle); Deebo 21% target share, 3 RZ targets Week 1.
items.implication: Must-add in 12-team; startable WR3/FLEX while Stribling out ~4 weeks.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29/32 early RB opps, 19 routes/33 dropbacks, 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. Full-grown-man role.
items.why: Dominated opportunities as expected post-trade; Berry also LOVES MNF performance.
items.implication: High-end RB1 ROS; every-down back with receiving upside.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty tied Bijan for No.1 RB Utilization Score (99) Week 1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes/21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 156 yds + 2 rec TDs. Upgrades to high-end RB1.
items.why: Every-down role + efficiency jump; Fantasy Life/Berry ecosystem data. ETR ROS discussing.
items.implication: Lock-in RB1; workhorse with receiving upside in new scheme.

items.text: ETR first Rest of Season Top-150 rankings live (Levitan et al.): discussing CMC, Travis Etienne, Rashee Rice, Ashton Jeanty and more with opportunity adjustments post-Week 1.
items.why: Post-Week 1 usage/injury data factored; trade calculator live too.
items.implication: Use for trades/ROS value; Etienne downgraded on committee signs per util data.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but played a horrific game. Bounce-back candidate on opportunity.
items.why: xFP model (targets/location/depth) showed elite opportunity; actual underperformed.
items.implication: Buy-low WR; start with confidence Week 2 on volume.

items.text: Travis Hunter played only 4 offensive snaps Week 1 in specialized package (jet/bubble/tunnel/decoy); no routes past LOS. JAX intentions clear via offseason moves (Meyers, BTJ interest, Washington).
items.why: Limited package matches offseason signals; long season but not primary WR yet.
items.implication: Hold for upside but not startable; BTJ/Meyers/Washington ahead.

items.text: Rashee Rice tiny career aDOT (4.9, 2.5 in W1) needs volume; only 2 targets/7% share but 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd to Worthy).
items.why: Routes present, volume/aDOT low; ETR ROS discussing him.
items.implication: Needs target spike for WR2 value; handcuff to Mahomes efficiency.
